title: Violet Fault Spire
description: A seven-metre violet blade growing with smaller intergrown crystals from a displaced limestone fissure; references: ref_07_violet_crater and ref_03_canyon_cliffs.

review.notes: Round 3 (final) against the round-2 points. Flat purple: not fixed. The prisms are still one uniform saturated blue-violet from base to tip with no dark core and no lighter rim; the colour leans blue, not the violet of ref_07 (hero.jpg, closeup.jpg). Inner bands: changed, not fixed. They are now pale opaque stripes painted straight across the faces, so the prisms read as banded tubes, not growth zones inside the crystal. Fix: a dark violet core fading to a lighter translucent-looking rim via a facing/thickness gradient, with 2-3 thin internal growth zones parallel to the terminations, darker than the body. Tips: starburst shading gone, but the terminations are still clean, perfect points with no chips or broken prisms. Fix: chip 2-3 terminations and break one prism off with a fresh fracture face. Crack: still a thin painted zigzag line on the main prism, not a modelled fracture, and it does not glow. Fix: cut a real fracture plane with a narrow emissive seam. The spire's satellite prisms repeat the same banding at the same spacing (hero.jpg).
